grs.title: Create a complaint draft
grs.intro: Type the facts or speak them. The draft is created in your browser and is not sent anywhere.
grs.privacy: Your text, images, PDFs and voice audio stay inside your browser. Nothing is uploaded, nothing is stored, and everything is cleared when you close or reload the page.

grs.micPermission: Microphone permission was denied. Allow it in the browser settings or type the details.
grs.micModelMissing: The local voice model is not installed on this server. Run `npm run fetch-models` in the project folder and try again; type the details until then.
grs.micNoSpeech: No speech was recognised. Try again or type the details.
grs.micFailed: The speech could not be transcribed. Try again or type the details.
grs.attachmentHint: Attach only what is needed and avoid unnecessary personal information. Files are never uploaded; they are read inside your browser.

grs.fileUnsupported: This file type is not accepted (images and PDF only).
grs.fileMalformed: The real content of the file could not be read—it may be damaged.

grs.fileDuplicate: This file has already been attached.
grs.extractedHint: Check the extracted text or remove it—errors would end up in the draft.

identity_check.title: Document consistency check
identity_check.intro: Add document images or PDFs. Their text is read inside your browser, and only the fields you choose are compared.
identity_check.privacy1: Nothing is uploaded. Images, PDFs, extracted text and the comparison result stay in your browser's memory and are cleared when you close or reload the page.
identity_check.privacy2: No online OCR or AI service receives the text. Reading happens on your device.
identity_check.privacy3: This does not prove that a document is genuine—it only shows differences in the text you supplied.
identity_check.fileHint: PNG/JPEG images or PDF only (12 MB maximum).
identity_check.truncated: Only the first pages were read—check the remaining pages yourself.
identity_check.fileTooLarge: The file is too large (12 MB maximum).
identity_check.fileUnsupported: Only images and PDF files are accepted.
identity_check.fileMalformed: The real content of the file could not be read.
identity_check.fileLimit: At most 3 documents can be added.
identity_check.reason_insufficient_values: Fill at least two values to compare.
identity_check.reason_all_equal: The text that was read is the same.
identity_check.reason_values_differ: The text differs—see the values below.
identity_check.reason_ambiguous_date: The date format is unclear, so day and month order cannot be determined.
identity_check.reason_unconfirmed_value: The text read from the file has not yet been verified.
identity_check.confirmHint: If the read text is wrong, correct it directly.
identity_check.boundaryTitle: What this tool does not do
identity_check.boundary: It only shows differences in text. It does not decide which value is correct, and it does not authenticate any document or person.
identity_check.correction: To find out which value to change, see the relevant correction guide:
identity_check.disclaimer: ShebaShathi BD is an independent citizen-help tool, not a government website.
identity_check.note: If the date or name format differs, it may show 'Differs'; it may also catch spelling or formatting differences.
identity_check.emptyDocs: To start comparing, add at least two documents or manual columns.
